project.description: Load NCBI GFF3 load file for GRCz12tu

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set -e # BEFORE snapshot of everything this load writes (GRCz12tu genome locations, the # gene -> assembly links and the NCBI annotation statuses, flattened one row per gene). # This load is run by hand and rarely -- a year between the last two runs -- so the # before/after diff is the only practical record of what a given run actually changed. OUT=$TARGETROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gff3Load/Load-NCBI-GFF3-File SQL=$SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gff3Load mkdir -p "$OUT" PSQL="psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PGHOST -d $DBNAME" $PSQL -v stage=tmp_gff3_loc_before -f $SQL/snapshot_gff3_ncbi_locations.sql $PSQL -c "\copy (SELECT * FROM tmp_gff3_loc_before ORDER BY gene_zdb_id, accession) TO STDOUT CSV HEADER" > "$OUT/gff3_locations_before.csv" echo "BEFORE rows: $(( $(wc -l < "$OUT/gff3_locations_before.csv") - 1 ))"

set -e # AFTER snapshot (post-load) + database-level diff. OUT=$TARGETROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gff3Load/Load-NCBI-GFF3-File SQL=$SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gff3Load PSQL="psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PGHOST -d $DBNAME" cd $SOURCEROOT $PSQL -v stage=tmp_gff3_loc_after -f $SQL/snapshot_gff3_ncbi_locations.sql $PSQL -c "\copy (SELECT * FROM tmp_gff3_loc_after ORDER BY gene_zdb_id, accession) TO STDOUT CSV HEADER" > "$OUT/gff3_locations_after.csv" echo "AFTER rows: $(( $(wc -l < "$OUT/gff3_locations_after.csv") - 1 ))" $PSQL -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_gff3_loc_before, tmp_gff3_loc_after" # key = the gene and its NCBI GeneID, so a gene whose coordinates moved lands in # updated_1/_2 rather than as a delete plus an add; gene_abbrev is readable-only. gradle csvDiff --args="$OUT/gff3_locations_dbdiff $OUT/gff3_locations_before.csv $OUT/gff3_locations_after.csv gene_zdb_id,accession gene_abbrev" # Roll the four diff CSVs into one workbook so the run's delta is a single attachment. csvDiff # writes the CSVs and nothing else on this branch, so the conversion is a separate explicit step. gradle csv2xlsx --args="$OUT/gff3_locations_dbdiff.xlsx $OUT/gff3_locations_dbdiff_deletes.csv $OUT/gff3_locations_dbdiff_adds.csv $OUT/gff3_locations_dbdiff_updated_1.csv $OUT/gff3_locations_dbdiff_updated_2.csv"
